messages:
Isha Varma: ping — Customer Meridian flagged INV-2026-1590: platform fee is $11,000 vs quoted $5,500 and support shows "Platinum" instead of "Standard". Can someone look? :wave:

Noah Kim: drop sub id and invoice snippet?

Isha Varma: sub MER-PRIV-58. invoice snip:
```
INV-2026-1590
Subscription: MER-PRIV-58
Private Deployment (reserved GPUs) - $36,000/year
Platform Fee - $11,000/year
Support - Platinum - $10,000/year
Total Due: $57,000
```
Quote/amendment (signed 2026-02-07) shows platform fee $5,500 and support Standard $5,000.

Billing Bot: invoice INV-2026-1590 generated at 2026-07-25T09:14:30Z by billing-service.

Nora Chen: quick checks: meter shows two short reserve_pool events (3/12 and 4/20) that triggered a platform true-up of +5.5k. Also I see support_sku defaulted to Platinum on renewal due to missing support_sku field in amendment metadata.

Noah Kim: did Sales approve the trial pools to be charged? I don't see waiver in CRM.

Isha Varma: Sales thread shows they intended to waive. Nora — can you confirm and attach any Sales note? If so we should credit the true-up and correct support SKU.

Nora Chen: Sales confirmed via DM (Isha pasted) and I'll attach the DM and the signed amendment (CRM MER-402). Proposed actions: 1) credit platform true-up $5,500, 2) correct support from Platinum ($10k) to Standard ($5k) and apply $5k credit, 3) reissue invoice with explanatory memo.

Isha Varma: Finance approval needed for combined credits = $10,500. Oliver? :pray:

Oliver (Finance): approved. This is contract remediation; within our approval limits. Proceed and note revrec impact.

Billing Bot: credit CR-2026-925 created for INV-2026-1590 amount $10,500. Reissued invoice INV-2026-1590-R. Memo: "Waive approved trial reserve pools; correct support tier per signed amendment." Attachments: MER-402_amendment.pdf, sales_waiver.eml

Noah Kim: credits applied and invoice reissued. I'll notify customer and RevRec. Closing thread.
